description: Sub-file for today live market data containing precomputed short-term static and long-term static data with specific columns, mathematical calculations, and plain-language interpretations.

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion

daily_oscillators.interpretation: Bollinger Bands bandwidth is tightly compressed at 5.66% (<6.5%), signaling an imminent explosive directional expansion.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 149.8% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 336.3).

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)
volatility_and_risk.interpretation: Expected daily session price fluctuation is Rs. 42.95 (3.5%). Setting stop-loss tighter than Rs. 53.69 incurs high premature shakeout risk.

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 1244.67. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 1262.34), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 1209.34).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: RSI is currently 50 with standard 20-EMA support at Rs. 1227.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 445.3% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 225).

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion

daily_oscillators.interpretation: RSI is currently 27.5 with standard 20-EMA support at Rs. 1557.26.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)
volatility_and_risk.interpretation: Expected daily session price fluctuation is Rs. 47.6 (3.5%). Setting stop-loss tighter than Rs. 59.5 incurs high premature shakeout risk.

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 1360. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 1360), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 1360).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: RSI is currently 50 with standard 20-EMA support at Rs. 1360.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%
audited_quarterly_fundamentals.interpretation: Annualized earning power of Rs. 15 per share on a book value of Rs. 150 generates an ROE of 10%.

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 504.4% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 225).

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)
volatility_and_risk.interpretation: Expected daily session price fluctuation is Rs. 36.27 (2.75%). Setting stop-loss tighter than Rs. 45.34 incurs high premature shakeout risk.

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 1320.37. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 1335.64), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 1302.74).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: Bollinger Bands bandwidth is tightly compressed at 4.17% (<6.5%), signaling an imminent explosive directional expansion.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%
audited_quarterly_fundamentals.interpretation: Annualized earning power of Rs. 47.03 per share on a book value of Rs. 285.09 generates an ROE of 10%.

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 140% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 549.2).

dividend_track_record.statistical_calculation: 5-year weighted mean of bonus share entitlements and cash dividend declarations
dividend_track_record.interpretation: Management retains capitalization via consistent stock bonus distributions.

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)
volatility_and_risk.interpretation: Expected daily session price fluctuation is Rs. 15.74 (3.03%). Setting stop-loss tighter than Rs. 19.68 incurs high premature shakeout risk.

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 521.3. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 541.6), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 499.7).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: Bollinger Bands bandwidth is tightly compressed at 4.1% (<6.5%), signaling an imminent explosive directional expansion.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%
audited_quarterly_fundamentals.interpretation: Annualized earning power of Rs. 15 per share on a book value of Rs. 150 generates an ROE of 10%.

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 131.1% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 225).

statutory_regulatory_fees.sebon_fee_description: SEBON regulatory fee: 0.015% of transaction value
statutory_regulatory_fees.dp_charge_description: Depository Participant (CDSC) fee: Rs. 25 flat per sold company per day
statutory_regulatory_fees.circuit_limit_description: Exchange circuit breaker limit: ±15% of previous session close (April 2026 regulation)

eod_price_reference.statistical_calculation: Circuit limits = prev_close * (1 ± 0.15) mandated by SEBON April 2026 rules
eod_price_reference.interpretation: Permitted daily session volatility band; order matching halts if prices hit either bound.

volatility_and_risk.statistical_calculation: Wilder 14-period True Range: MA of Max(H-L, |H-Cp|, |L-Cp|)
volatility_and_risk.interpretation: Expected daily session price fluctuation is Rs. 10.09 (2.59%). Setting stop-loss tighter than Rs. 12.61 incurs high premature shakeout risk.

pivot_points.statistical_calculation: PP = (High + Low + Close) / 3; R1 = 2*PP - Low; S1 = 2*PP - High; Camarilla H4/L4 range expansion
pivot_points.interpretation: Intraday bullish inflection pivot sits at Rs. 384.83. Target 1 supply wall sits at R1 (Rs. 396.16), with demand floor cushion at S1 (Rs. 377.66).

daily_oscillators.interpretation: Bollinger Bands bandwidth is tightly compressed at 4.35% (<6.5%), signaling an imminent explosive directional expansion.

smart_money_5d_flow.statistical_calculation: BCR3 = (Top 3 Buyers Net Kitta / Total Net Buying) * 100; Operator Floor = Lead Broker Buy VWAP
smart_money_5d_flow.interpretation: Net order flow indicates BALANCED_FLOW. Caution advised near supply pockets.

tactical_consensus.statistical_calculation: Quant score synthesized from Wyckoff order flow (35%), trend alignment (35%), and ATR risk geometry (30%)

corporate_capital_structure.statistical_calculation: Paid Up Capital = Total Listed Shares * Face Value (100); Float % = (Public Kitta / Total Shares)*100
corporate_capital_structure.interpretation: Low-float capital structure with only 49.0 Lakh public shares (49%). Promoters hold 51%.

audited_quarterly_fundamentals.statistical_calculation: EPS = Annualized Net Profit / Shares; BVPS = Net Worth / Shares; ROE = (Net Profit / Net Worth)*100%
audited_quarterly_fundamentals.interpretation: Annualized earning power of Rs. 15 per share on a book value of Rs. 150 generates an ROE of 10%.

valuation_models.statistical_calculation: Benjamin Graham Fair Value = SQRT(22.5 * EPS * BVPS); Margin of Safety = ((Fair Value - Price) / Fair Value)*100%
valuation_models.interpretation: Trading at a premium of 72.9% over Graham intrinsic value (Rs. 225).
